description: For 256-bit: extract top 64 bits, compute cofactors via fast 64-bit half-GCD, apply transformation matrix to reduce full-width operands.
mathematical_formalization: Extract top 64 bits. Compute 2x2 cofactor matrix from 64-bit half-GCD. Apply: a'=u00*a+u01*b; b'=u10*a+u11*b.
implementation_hypothesis: For 256-bit: extract top limb, run branchless 64-bit GCD for cofactors, multiply 4-limb numbers by 2x2 matrix. Repeat.
experiment_seed: Compare against naive 256-bit binary GCD. Measure iteration reduction and limb multiplication cost.
